fees.description: Temporary disconnection fee - applicable when energy is temporarily disconnected to the property. Wasted site visit fee of $49.50 (gst incl) applies if work cannot be completed.
Basic permanent disconnection fee - applicable when energy is permanently disconnected to the property. Wasted site visit fee of $184.80 (gst incl) applies if work cannot be completed.

Basic urgent permanent disconnection fee - applicable when energy is urgently permanently disconnected to the property. Wasted site visit fee of $246.40 (gst incl), applies if work cannot be completed.
Reconnection fee - applicable when energy is reconnected to the property.  Wasted site visit fee of $71.50 (gst incl) applies if work cannot be completed.
Special meter read (including moving in and moving out of your supply address). Fee also applies for a wasted site visit to read the meter.
Late Payment Fee may be applied, if applicable (GST is not applicable).
Direct Debit Rejection Fee (GST is not applicable).
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by credit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by debit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.

gasContract.terms: A copy of the Standard Retail Contract can be provided on request and can be seen on our website. Refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/your-rights-and-obligations.
gasContract.variation: If we vary our standing offer prices, we will publish the notification of a variation in a newspaper and on our website at least 10 business days before it starts. We will also: notify you at least five business days before the variation in the standing offer prices or miscellaneous fees and charges are to apply to you; and deliver the notice by your preferred form of communication where you have communicated this to us, or otherwise by the same method as that used for delivery of your bill.

incentives.description: The Carbon Neutral Gas opt-in product offsets the emissions from your natural gas usage. Certified by Climate Active, you can opt-in for $1.50 per week inc. GST, applied to your natural gas account. For more information visit https://www.actewagl.com.au/sustainability/carbon-neutral-gas.

gasContract.additionalFeeInformation: For information on additional fees, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/charges-and-rates.
